items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And so I have always thought of her as a great friend, and a very helpful human being, who understood my plight.

ctx.x: Yes, a nun who was one of my teachers in high school. She was a science teacher and so certainly had nothing to do with my endeavors. But she was a very human kind of person who believed that what I wanted so desperately -- and making the way for my plans for the future as a young man, and she coped with me and put up with me, and was very helpful to me.

And so I have always thought of her as a great friend, and a very helpful human being, who understood my plight. And consequently I put the scholarship fund in her name, along with mine. It's the Sister Fabian-Woody Herman Scholarship Fund.
